objective: One consequential claim becomes scoped, reproducible, correctable evidence and a useful delivered outcome; expansion follows measured demand and reliability.

phases.title: Control, baseline and consolidation
phases.exit_intent: One evidence ledger, one lifecycle, explicit scope, rights and ownership.

phases.title: Release closure
phases.exit_intent: A reproducible candidate, correct runtime, complete route audit and authorised production readback.

phases.title: Inspector and user journeys
phases.exit_intent: A stranger can find, understand, inspect, verify, challenge and retrieve scoped evidence.

phases.title: Living measurement
phases.exit_intent: Material changes create bounded, authorised work with independent review and preserved history.

phases.title: CARE, human evidence and improvement
phases.exit_intent: Consent, human evidence and model-change review without fabricated trust or self-promotion.

phases.title: Commercial RAS delivery
phases.exit_intent: An external buyer purchases a defined deliverable, receives it and can verify its scope.

phases.title: Public distribution and engagement
phases.exit_intent: Useful approved evidence earns discovery, qualified enquiries and repeat use.

phases.title: Expansion and continuous improvement
phases.exit_intent: Expand only after reliability, reproducibility, demand and unit economics are evidenced.

lanes.title: Release/integration
lanes.rule: One writer for a given checkout; isolated tests; no release without approval.

lanes.title: Measurement/inspection
lanes.rule: Pinned inputs; reviewer separation; no grade from a disclosure or signature alone.

lanes.title: Inspector/user/agent experience
lanes.rule: One canonical Dashboard and request identity across surfaces.

lanes.title: Operations/data
lanes.rule: Reuse existing observer, queue, STOP, budgets and private fleet entrypoint.

lanes.title: Commercial delivery
lanes.rule: No public prices; free verification; owner-issued quote/invoice; no agent wallets.

lanes.title: Research/distribution
lanes.rule: Primary sources; rights review; approved email batches only; no publication until release gates.
